# secureaccess_regions (Data Source)

This data source reads the regions that Secure Access offers for Network Tunnel Groups. It requires an API key with the `deployments.regions:read` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_regions" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) The regions, in the order in which the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `continent` (String) Continent of the region.
- `description` (String) Country and location of the region.
- `name` (String) Display name of the region. To select a region for a Network Tunnel Group use `region`, not `name`.
- `region` (String) Identifier of the region. This is the value to use for the `region` of a Network Tunnel Group.
